title: Gloss Entity Overlays Document
description: Default nearby living-entity overlays at plugins/Gloss/entity-overlays/default.json, with segmented health, custom names, damage feedback, combat stats and optional React/Adapt data.

range.description: Nearby range in blocks; clamped to 1..64.

updateIntervalTicks.description: Update interval in ticks; clamped to 1..40.

maxEntitiesPerViewer.description: Maximum overlays per viewer; clamped to 1..256.

verticalOffset.description: Blocks above entity bounds; clamped to -2..8.

hitHighlightMs.description: Recent-hit highlight in milliseconds; clamped to 0..10000.

healthFormat.description: Tokens: {bar}, {health}, {max_health}. With showHealthNumbers false only the bar renders.

stackFormat.description: React count token: {count}; appended to the name or health line for stacks greater than one.
